description: Defines test utilities, mock classes, and test context classes for reporting components in Chromium, including test implementations of ReportingUploader, ReportingDelegate, ReportingContext, and a test reporting service.

classes.name: TestReportingUploader
classes.description: Test implementation of ReportingUploader that stores pending uploads for examination and completion.

classes.name: TestReportingDelegate
classes.description: Test implementation of ReportingDelegate controlling report permissions and checks.

classes.name: TestReportingContext
classes.description: Test implementation of ReportingContext using test clocks, timers, and uploader.

classes.name: ReportingTestBase
classes.description: Base class providing a test reporting context and utility methods for testing reporting components.

classes.name: TestReportingService
classes.description: Test implementation of ReportingService that records reports and manages reporting policies.

methods.name: ReportUrlIs
methods.description: Matcher to verify that a report's URL matches the expected URL.

methods.name: TestReportingRandIntCallback
methods.description: Function returning a callback for generating random integers in tests.
